final: WITH group_avgs AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(pav.points_won) as avg_points_won FROM player_award_vote pav JOIN player p ON pav.player_id = p.player_id WHERE p.death_country IS NOT NULL AND p.death_country != '' GROUP BY p.death_country), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points_won) as overall_avg FROM group_avgs) SELECT ga.death_country, ga.avg_points_won, ga.avg_points_won - oa.overall_avg as distance_from_group_average_mean FROM group_avgs ga CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY ga.death_country
